content: The Clinical Skills Online (CSO) project was developed by the Educational Technology Unit at St George's, University of London, UK. Its purpose is to provide online videos that demonstrate essential clinical skills, which are fundamental to a wide range of medical and healthcare-related courses in higher education. These videos are freely accessible to anyone, provided they are used solely for educational, personal, and non-commercial purposes. All content on the CSO website, including text, images, videos, and other original works, is licensed under Creative Commons unless otherwise specified. It is important to note that the clinical skills videos available on the CSO platform have been created at a lowest common denominator level. This approach ensures that the content is broadly applicable across various medical and healthcare disciplines, with the intention of sharing it with the wider community. Additionally, users should be aware that there may be slight variations in the procedures demonstrated in the videos. These differences can arise due to variations in institutional policies and the specific equipment used at different organizations.
